create_maskrcnn_perception_module: create a MaskRCNNPerception instance with a confidence threshold and GPU id for COCO object detection
run_maskrcnn_predict: run MaskRCNNPerception predict on an Observations object to get semantic segmentation and instance maps
setup_detectron2_cfg: setup a Detectron2 config from command-line args with confidence threshold and model weights options
run_visualization_demo_on_images: run VisualizationDemo on a batch of BGR images to get predictions and visualizations
call_batch_predictor: call BatchPredictor on a batch of BGR images to get instance segmentation predictions
